# Title decoder fixtures

`generate.py` authors the synthetic container, group-split, indexed-sprite and
simple-font fixtures. They are fixed golden inputs; tests assert interpretation,
not merely encode/decode round trips. Containers exercise none/headerless bzip2/
gzip; the sprite file exercises offsets, transparent index 0, palette-zero repair,
column-major storage and a separate alpha plane.

Behavioral evidence: RustOSRS gitlink
`854a3962164ad401d21064a5f207f86869ea69b4`, cache `encode/store.rs`,
`encode/reference_table.rs`, `transport.rs`, `decode/sprite.rs`; RuneLite-melxin
revision 235 checkout (since removed from `references/`; see RustClient Git history) `1ad572d7dcdbc0fb67a4a00f0c2f959d5ab25abc`,
`AbstractFont.java` and `LoginScreenAnimation.java`.

`live-graphics-defaults.bin` is the 85-byte decoded index 17/group 3/file 0 from
`/Users/tylercovalt/Desktop/LIVE`. It is retained to freeze the observed 240
opcode-6 twelve-slot list and opcode-5 pair of 32-bit fields, in addition to
opcode-3 palette stops. Those extra graphics fields are consumed but not exposed
as supported model/sprite definitions. Its exact hash is asserted in the profile
unit test. This fixture is not regenerated by the synthetic generator.

No test requires the reference source or full LIVE directory. The explicit
inspection/capture commands provide separate local integration evidence.

`widgets/if1-0.bin` through `if1-8.bin` are synthetic, independently authored
revision-240 `Widget.method7215` vectors, reproducible with `widgets/generate.py`.
They intentionally use model IDs 70000/80000 (32-bit selectors), unsigned parent
links, comparison/CS1 words, CP1252 text, alternate styles, target flags and a
hover-only tooltip. `legacy_widgets.rs` checks every truncation boundary and
trailing bytes separately from graph validation. They do not claim CS1 execution
or complete IF1 painting/action support.
